what_it_does: Achieves an exceptionally dense high-speed memory storage system (SRAM) for processor chips manufactured at 2 nanometer technology, storing 38.1 megabits per square millimeter. The design works by making the individual memory cells slightly smaller but compensating by increasing how many bit lines (data wires) each memory cell can drive simultaneously. Specialized layout rules and floor-planning ensure both the tiny memory cells and their supporting peripheral circuitry fit efficiently while maintaining reliable operation at reduced voltages.
